stories.head: True Anomaly raises $190M for co-orbital security
stories.body: True Anomaly has secured $190M in Series C funding, bringing its valuation to $1.6B. The company focuses on co-orbital security and space domain awareness, with the Department of Defense showing strong interest in its capabilities. As threats in orbit become more pronounced, True Anomaly’s funding suggests a growing recognition of the need for robust security measures.
stories.soWhat: This funding is less about innovation and more about responding to urgent military needs; cash flows where the risk is highest.

stories.head: Europe's space defense strategy remains underdeveloped
stories.body: Despite ramping up military capabilities across various domains, Europe seems to be neglecting its space defense strategy. This oversight is akin to bringing a knife to a gunfight, as highlighted by the lack of coordinated efforts among EU nations. With geopolitical tensions rising, the absence of a unified space defense strategy could leave Europe vulnerable.
stories.soWhat: If Europe can't get its act together in space, it risks being left behind in the next phase of military modernization.

stories.head: Muon Space unveils Starship-class satellite platform
stories.body: Muon Space has introduced a Starship-class satellite platform aimed at the orbital data center market, with a launch scheduled for 2028. This ambitious project comes as the demand for data processing in space grows, but the timeline raises eyebrows about market readiness. The company is positioning itself as a player in a competitive field that includes established giants.
stories.soWhat: If Muon Space takes too long to launch, it might find itself in a crowded market where first-mover advantage is key.

watchlist.title: Keep an eye on Blue Origin's launch plans
watchlist.body: Blue Origin's aim to resume New Glenn launches by year-end could impact the competitive landscape for heavy-lift capabilities.

watchlist.title: Monitor Anduril and L3Harris collaboration
watchlist.body: Their tactical SDA constellation bid could set a precedent for future collaborations in defense-focused satellite systems.

watchlist.title: Watch for updates on the FY27 budget
watchlist.body: The $1.4B addition to space resilience funding indicates a prioritization of space in national security, which could affect procurement strategies.

watchlist.title: True Anomaly's market positioning
watchlist.body: As True Anomaly's funding solidifies its position, competitors will need to respond to its growing influence in co-orbital security.

talent.statLabel: Job orders YoY · plus 2 starters per head, an 8-year first
talent.head: Demand has doubled. So has our hit rate.
talent.body: EVONA's job orders are up 2.0× year-over-year, and for the first time in our eight-year history we're placing two new starters per EVONA staff member. The first number says demand is real. The second says we're converting it, which in recruitment is the only number that actually matters. Growth is heaviest in Series B/C startups; primes are running flat. Compensation isn't the variable. The constraint is schedule risk in the primes: senior engineers leave Boeing, Lockheed, Northrop because they want to ship hardware before retirement.
